purpose: Author-authorized correction of the duplicated 2.25 cm offset in the sphere-centre FEM query feature; all labels, annotations, splits and hyperparameters fixed.
annotation_rule: Recover a missing polygon only when the probe can be unambiguously localized in the actual frame. Do not infer a location from default distances or prediction errors. Otherwise exclude that frame from scalar regression, retaining it for visualization.
existing_valid_annotations: Retain all polygons and the same nearest-conductor surface-distance labels. Remove the duplicated sphere-radius addition only from the centre-distance FEM query.
hyperparameters: Fixed to the published residual configuration; no new search or score-based dataset selection.
preprocessing: Fit physical scaler, PCA and visual scaler only on each training fold. Use clean validation/test features. Recompute local visual features when an annotation is recovered.
training_order: Train physical ensemble, freeze it, then fit the visual residual sequentially on in-sample physical residuals, matching the previous protocol.
comparison: Report original saved and corrected predictions on common holdout frames; recovered holdout frames, if any, reported separately. No claim of a fresh independent test.
paper_status: Integrate this fixed correction into the 10-page camera-ready manuscript.

calibration.fit: ordinary least squares of ln(V/1 V) against ln(d/1 cm), one global calibration fitted only to the five experimental LED pairs
calibration.label_curve: A*(d/1 cm)**(-gamma), positive distances; no artificial endpoint anchors and no target clipping
calibration.out_of_range_policy: Retain positive query distances; identify extrapolated labels and separately report interval/extrapolation subsets. Applies to every model, without selection on results.
calibration.empirical_feature: negative centered finite-difference derivative, half-step 0.05 cm, same fitted power law; no slope clipping required at retained queries
calibration.source: Figure 3 and author confirmation; observed manual activation distances, color-estimated threshold voltages, LED legs separated by 2 cm

geometry.centre_distance_cm: s*norm(probe_centroid - sphere_centroid), without adding Rs again
geometry.label_distance: same signed nearest-conductor polygon surface distance as previous run
geometry.figure5: same nearest-conductor surface-distance law outside masked conductor polygons; half-source-pixel positive floor for display only
